Description: In Edmund Galley’s room, Tony Dauer entrusts an important item to Eve Dauer for safekeeping. After explicitly stating it is connected to John Hobbes, he leaves alone and never returns.
Location: Edmund Galley’s room (Edmund's room)
Key Information:
  - Tony Dauer hands an important, expensive-looking item of unknown origin to Eve Dauer for safekeeping and demands secrecy from others.
  - Tony Dauer explicitly states the item is connected to John Hobbes and judges that John Hobbes is looking for it.
  - Eve Dauer doubts the item’s origin and asks whether it was stolen, but still agrees to hide it for now.
  - Tony Dauer says John Hobbes is in the Kitchen (Kitchen) talking with Edmund Galley.
  - Tony Dauer distinguishes John Hobbes from Oswald (Oswald) and denies that Oswald is related to the item.
  - Oswald has a comical small mustache.
  - Tony Dauer mentions that earlier, when everyone gathered in the Living room (Living room), Oswald and Annie Beaumont appeared together in the Attic (Attic).
  - Tony Dauer says he needs to go out to fetch another important item and instructs Eve Dauer not to let strangers into the room.
  - Tony Dauer slams the door when leaving Edmund Galley’s room, and never returns to that room afterward.
Characters:
  [Tony Dauer (Tony Dauer)] Person No. 4, Eve Dauer’s younger brother.
    · Hands an important item to Eve Dauer to hide.
    · Explicitly states the item is connected to John Hobbes.
    · Leaves the room at the end of the node and does not return.
  [Eve Dauer (Eve Dauer)] Person No. 10, Tony Dauer’s older sister.
    · Accepts and temporarily safeguards the important item Tony Dauer hands over.
    · Doubts the item’s origin but does not refuse to help hide it.
